The percentage of children and adolescents with untreated dental caries increased with age: 6.1% among those aged 6–11 years
During 2011–2014, 13.3% of children and adolescents aged 6–19 years had untreated dental caries in their permanent teeth.
6.1% among those aged 6–11 years, 14.5% among those aged 12–15 years, and 22.6% among those aged 16–19 years.
Data were collected by dentists in the mobile examination center as part of the oral health component of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated with error bars.
